definitions.explanation: One of two sides of something, such as a road, body, or object. Often used for roads, escalators, and physical objects that have two symmetrical sides.

examples.japanese: {片側|かたがわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{空|あ}ける→空ける：18694_akeru⟧。
{片側|かたがわ}{一車線|いちしゃせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧です。
examples.english: It's a road with one lane in each direction.

examples.japanese: ⟦エスカレーター→エスカレーター：01338_esukareetaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{片側|かたがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}って→寄る：02440_yoru⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦マナー→マナー：11139_manaa⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It is considered good manners to stand on one side of the escalator.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧ (one of a pair) and ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (side). Frequently used when referring to one side of a road, street, or other symmetrical space.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {片側|かたがわ}⟦{通行|つうこう}→通行：03436_tsuukou⟧ — one-way traffic (on one side)
- {片側|かたがわ}{一車線|いちしゃせん} — one lane per side
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{片側|かたがわ} — one side of the road
- {片側|かたがわ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧ — only one side

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{両側|りょうがわ}→両側：28877_ryougawa⟧ — both sides (antonym)
- ⟦{向|む}こう{側|がわ}→向こう側：08504_mukougawa⟧ — the other side, opposite side
- ⟦{反対側|はんたいがわ}→反対側：16780_hantaigawa⟧ — the opposite side
